content: CLIProxyAPI (Go, read source 2026-09-28): pairwise translators on raw JSON bytes registered by (from,to) format under internal/translator/<from>/<to>; ProviderExecutor interface {Execute, ExecuteStream(headers + chunk channel), Refresh, CountTokens, HttpRequest}; auth Manager (conductor) handles selection/cooldown/refresh; readStreamBootstrap buffers chunks until first non-empty payload so failover can happen before any byte is sent (StreamingBootstrapRetries).
